name: Shaped Fist
description: Shape a dense lump of qi about the fist and strike so the lump adds its weight to the blow.

name: Air Rung
description: Make a firm rung of qi in the air and step off it to cross a short gap.

name: Mold Plate
description: Mold a plate of dense qi before the forearm to take a blow.

name: Spark Maker
description: Kindle a small ember of new force in the fist so the next blow lands harder.

name: Needle Spawn
description: Make a thin needle of qi between the fingers and flick it at a target.

name: Pliant Grip
description: Make a loop of soft qi-stuff about a foe's wrist and draw it tight.

name: Craft Pebble
description: Make a hard pebble of qi from nothing and throw it at the face.

name: Quick Buckler
description: Make a small round buckler of qi on the arm in time to catch a thrust.

name: Knit Skin
description: Make fresh skin over a shallow cut or scrape on an ally or the user.

name: Hard Spur
description: Make a short post of hard qi in a foe's path so the stride trips on it.

name: Coil Cord
description: Make a cord of qi that coils about a foe's ankles and holds them.

name: Conjure Edge
description: Conjure a short edge of hard qi along the hand and cut with it in one stroke.

name: Conjure Pike
description: Conjure a narrow pike of qi and thrust it into one point on the foe.

name: Edge Parry
description: Conjure a blade in the off hand and turn a thrust aside with its flat.

name: Edge Throw
description: Conjure a throwing blade and hurl it before it fades from the fingers.

name: Blade Vault
description: Plant a conjured blade point in the ground and vault off its hilt to a new spot.

name: Whet Edge
description: Make a conjured edge thinner and harder so the next cuts bite deeper.

name: Renew Touch
description: Lay a hand on a bruise or small wound and make new flesh to close it.

name: Fresh Breath
description: Make a clean draught of qi in the lungs to ease labored breath and lengthen endurance.

name: Bright Ward
description: Make a glowing shell of qi round the chest that takes a blow and then fades.

name: Kindle Jab
description: Jab with a fist that kindles a burst of new force at the moment of contact.

name: Draft Step
description: Make a draught of force behind the heel and push off it into a long stride.
